Step 2 — Update src/components/AddToCartButton.tsx to call useLanguage(). Add `import { useLanguage } from '@/context/LanguageContext';` and `const { t } = useLanguage();` inside the component. Replace the hardcoded button label strings: 'Added!' → t('product.addedToCart'), 'Adding...' → t('product.adding'), 'Out of Stock' → t('product.outOfStock'), 'Add to Cart' → t('product.addToCart'). File: src/components/AddToCartButton.tsx

Step 3 — Update src/components/SortSelect.tsx to call useLanguage(). Add import and `const { t } = useLanguage();`. Replace the SORT_OPTIONS array to use t() for labels: 'Newest First' → t('sort.newest'), 'Price: Low → High' → t('sort.priceAsc'), 'Price: High → Low' → t('sort.priceDesc'), 'Top Rated' → t('sort.rating'). Move SORT_OPTIONS inside the component so it re-evaluates on language change. File: src/components/SortSelect.tsx

Step 4 — Update src/components/QuantitySelector.tsx to call useLanguage(). Add import and `const { t } = useLanguage();`. Replace: 'Quantity:' → t('cart.quantity'), '(Max: {maxStock})' → `(${t('cart.max')} ${maxStock})`, 'Add to Cart' → t('product.addToCart'), 'Added to Cart!' → t('cart.addedToCart'), 'Adding...' → t('product.adding'). File: src/components/QuantitySelector.tsx

Step 5 — Update src/components/CartItemRow.tsx to call useLanguage(). Add import and `const { t } = useLanguage();`. Replace hardcoded 'Remove' → t('cart.remove'). File: src/components/CartItemRow.tsx
